products.definition: OS-level optimization source parsed from APBX YAML and bundled assets.
Bundled app inspected from {source}.exe metadata/strings only.

backendStatusDefinitions.implemented-live: Confirmed backend execution exists and is paired with rollback or backup metadata plus validation evidence.
backendStatusDefinitions.preview-only: Backend can inventory, classify, or produce a dry-run plan, but does not apply the change.
backendStatusDefinitions.catalog-only: Backend has static catalog/sample knowledge only; no live inventory or apply path.
backendStatusDefinitions.missing: No equivalent backend capability exists yet.
backendStatusDefinitions.unsafe: Source action is destructive or security-sensitive and must not be implemented without a dedicated safety design.
backendStatusDefinitions.blocked: Capability cannot be safely mapped from source-only inspection, usually because Dash internals were not decompiled or third-party installers/binaries are opaque.

rollbackOrBackupRules: Game Tune and persistent policy sessions write backup manifests before confirmed process-control changes.
Stop-GameTuneSession.ps1 restores priority, affinity, I/O priority, and GPU priority from backup.
Stop-ProcessPolicySession.ps1 restores persistent process policy controls from backup.
Stop-ProcessGovernorSession.ps1 restores governor restraints from backup.
New-CleanupDeletionManifest.ps1 emits preview-only backup requirements for files, registry exports, services, scheduled tasks, and startup entries.
backend/uninstall/uninstall-policy.json marks official uninstall and cleanup deletion as preview-only.
Standby memory, timer resolution, power plan, and service pause actions are preview-only and blocked from real system mutation.
Shader cache cleanup supports backup/delete/restore only for disposable temp fixtures.
Restore-StutterOptimization.ps1 restores shader-cache fixture files from a rollback manifest.
Preview-NvidiaNipProfile.ps1 emits export-before-import gates and rollback manifest metadata.
Invoke-NvidiaNipProfile.ps1 and Restore-NvidiaNipProfile.ps1 construct NVPI command contracts but do not launch NVIDIA Profile Inspector.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: Dash explicitly targets flushing standby memory for memory-heavy game stutter; 16 GB with OBS and Discord makes memory pressure a first-order suspect.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Read-only memory pressure evidence, standby list size capture, confirmed clear action, before/after validation, and no persistent state write.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: Timer resolution can affect input/audio/frame pacing; APBX bundles a dedicated SetTimerResolution executable and Dash exposes a timer toggle.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Backend-owned timer lifecycle with process/task cleanup, measured current/min/max timer evidence, rollback, and validation.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: Power plan and power-state pinning directly affect CPU clock residency and frame-time consistency while streaming.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Capture current active plan, import/apply only reviewed plans, restore previous GUID, and validate active scheme.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: Dash names DirectX/NVIDIA/AMD/Intel/Steam shader caches; stale shader caches can present as game stutter after driver/game changes.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Preview per-cache paths, protect active game/OBS files, backup/delete manifest, and validation by path count/bytes only after confirmation.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: OBS upload and Discord voice make network jitter visible; Dash/playbook both target TCP/offload/throttling/adapter settings.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Adapter-specific inventory, original advanced-property snapshot, allowlist by NIC/vendor, rollback, and latency/packet-loss validation.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: Contains graphics, memory-management, GameDVR/Game Bar, WER, and scheduler-adjacent settings likely related to frame pacing.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Registry snapshot/restore, reboot requirement tracking, anti-cheat compatibility gates, and benchmark/ETW validation.

topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.whyFor16GbObsDiscordOverwatch: Background services can compete with CPU/memory/disk while streaming, but blanket service stops are risky.
topMissingOptimizationsFor16GbObsDiscord.safeBackendNeeded: Per-service allowlist, dependency graph, state snapshot, time-boxed session restore, and OBS/Discord/game protection.

safetyNotes: No WinUI app launch, AME Wizard run, playbook application, {source}.exe execution, registry/service/driver/cleanup/uninstall/privacy/power/network/security mutation was performed.
backend/state is intentionally not used by these catalogs or tests.
Capabilities marked implemented-live must retain executable backend scripts, rollback/backup rules, and validation evidence.
